notes.title: New premium items in Epic Store!!
notes.content:
[ver. 1.2.3.0] New premium items in Epic Store!!
Added : Fast Attendance in QoL4 of Epic Store, which enables allocated monsters in challenge-base improvement to be stayed through Ascension
Added : Formation Save in QoL5 of Epic Store, which adds a button to save/load Ascension Spirit allocation in Ascension Formation

Hi, thank you for the wonderful feedback!!
In this update,  you can buy new QoL items in Epic Store. Please try it.
We, the IEB development team, will continue to work on improving this game!!

tags.feature: Added : Fast Attendance in QoL4 of Epic Store, which enables allocated monsters in challenge-base improvement to be stayed through Ascension
Added : Formation Save in QoL5 of Epic Store, which adds a button to save/load Ascension Spirit allocation in Ascension Formation

notes.title: Bug fixes and new stuff addition
notes.content:
[ver. 1.2.2.0] Bug fixes and new stuff addition
Added : "Shift-D" to destroy Golden Treasure Chest
Added : "Shift-Z" for x50,"Shift-X" for x100
Added : Japanese and Chinese texts for Golden Treasure Chest
Fixed : IEH Bonus event now works correctly
Fixed : Emphasized purchases with Ascend Spirit in Ascend Store

Hi, thank you for playing IEB!
IEH Bonus Event on Windows didn't work properly. We apologize for that. Now, we fixed this issue and made it possible to use bonus points.
New stuff has been added as well!
Please continue to enjoy the IEB!

notes.title: [ver. 1.2.1.0] Buffed the progress at the beginning of the game!!
notes.content:
[ver. 1.2.1.0] Buffed the progress at the beginning of the game
Balanced : Buffed nitro activation time
Balanced : Buffed block gains
Balanced : Buffed Improvement gains
Balanced : Decreased the cost of unlocking blocks
Fixed : a bug of research in Base Improvement of Challenge

Thank you for playing IEB and giving wonderful feedback.
Based on your feedback, we much buffed the progress at the beginning of the game. Please try it again :)
While offline, nitro is charged a lot and you can progress much faster with nitro booster, so let's use it!
We will keep developing and improving IEB more and more. Anyway, thank you for continued supports!

tags.balance_change: Decreased the cost of unlocking blocks

tags.bug: Fixed : a bug of research in Base Improvement of Challenge
